gloss: gold bar; gold ingot; gold nugget

definitions.gloss: gold bar; gold ingot; lump of gold
definitions.explanation: A solid mass of gold, whether a refined bar or ingot held as an asset, or a natural nugget. Used for gold held as a store of value or recovered from mining.

examples.japanese: {金庫|きんこ}に{金塊|きんかい}を{保管|ほかん}する。
examples.english: To store gold bars in a safe.

examples.japanese: {税関|ぜいかん}で{金塊|きんかい}の{密輸|みつゆ}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: Smuggled gold bars were discovered at customs.

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}が{不安定|ふあんてい}になると、{金塊|きんかい}を{買|か}う{投資家|とうしか}が{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: When the economy grows unstable, more investors buy gold bullion.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金塊|きんかい}を{保管|ほかん}する: to store gold bars
- {金塊|きんかい}の{密輸|みつゆ}: gold smuggling
- {純金|じゅんきん}の{金塊|きんかい}: a pure-gold ingot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {延|の}べ{棒|ぼう}: bar, ingot — the long bar shape specifically.
- {地金|じがね}: bullion, base metal — the raw metal as material rather than a shaped bar.
